Topic × time heatmap

Which conversations ran when: post counts per topic per week since the delay (or per UTC day), with engagement and sentiment split on hover.

Columns Colour
Numbers in cells = posts. Bars on the right = topic totals; bars on top = period totals. Hover a cell for engagement, sentiment split and its top post; click to pin.

Method

  • Topics are the dataset’s model-assigned single topic per post (15 topics). Rows are sorted by total posts.
  • Weeks are 7-day windows counted from the delay post (week 1 = Sep 14 16:00:01 → Sep 21 16:00:01 UTC, matching weekly.csv); week 4 is partial (~3 days, to Oct 8 16:28 UTC). Day columns are UTC calendar days; Sep 14 is partial (from 16:00 UTC).
  • Counts and engagement include all posts, official ones too (the tooltip shows how many were official). The sentiment split and the “net sentiment” colour exclude official Ubisoft/Rayman accounts. Net sentiment = (Positive − Negative) ÷ non-official posts in the cell; Mixed counts in the denominator only. Cells with fewer than 5 non-official posts are hatched in net-sentiment mode. Sentiment scores use the dataset's sentiment_score column (−1…+1, model-assessed). All posts had a score.
  • Engagement = likes + reposts + quotes + replies + bookmarks, snapshot at fetch time (late posts are still accumulating).
Built 2026-10-08 17:21 UTC from posts.csv (1,742 posts). Window 2026-09-14T16:00:01Z → 2026-10-08T16:28:00Z. Engagement = likes+reposts+quotes+replies+bookmarks (snapshot at fetch time).
